title: Wings of Wishes

outfit_card.silhouette: A layered couture gown with a fitted corseted bodice, voluminous puff sleeves, and a full skirt with sheer overskirts, featuring asymmetric folded-paper structural accents and a majestic, flowing train.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: An elaborate ornate headpiece composed of folded paper stars, sheer ribbon bows, and delicate lace frills, arranged asymmetrically atop the hair.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: A structured satin bodice with a high ruffled collar, adorned with a large golden bow and jeweled center. The voluminous puff sleeves are crafted from sheer organza with lace trims and metallic cuffs.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: A multi-tiered skirt with pleated layers, sheer tulle petticoats, and a prominent gold V-shaped waist panel. Includes delicate white lace stockings and elegant heeled boots with star motifs.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: Floating origami paper stars, folded-paper wing structures, and delicate golden accents that appear to flutter around the ensemble like whispered wishes.
